name: M3_OIS100MI_AddOrderHead
description: Create a new customer order header directly in customer order entry without using the batch order interface or batch order entry. The operation performs the same validations as interactive entry and creates a firm customer order header immediately. If any validation error occurs, it returns a message and no header is created. Warning messages also stop creation unless the ignore‑warnings setting is activated. On success, the operation returns the created order number together with up to ten message ID/text pairs that provide additional information, warnings, or non‑blocking issues. UTC handling and agreement selection behavior can be controlled through dedicated input fields.
